Films rubric (Фильмы)
nodes.rationale: Movie recommendation carousel: film stills with torn-paper caption card giving title, year, genre tags and a short blurb (e.g. 500 Days of Summer)

nodes.label: Where rubric (Где)
nodes.rationale: Venue-guide carousel; cover uses flat light-blue palette, crystal ball, bat and stars for a "magical atmosphere" places theme

nodes.label: Lifehacks rubric (Лайфхаки)
nodes.rationale: Productivity tips carousel in orange with line-art illustration of a woman at a laptop and a checklist ("how to work more productively")

nodes.label: Weekly plans rubric (Планы на неделю)
nodes.rationale: Weekly events digest; cover with St Petersburg drawbridge photo cut into a jagged blue frame under bold title

nodes.label: Seasonal rubric (Сезонная)
nodes.rationale: Seasonal content ("Autumn in Piter: where to play board games"); tall format with illustrated character and autumn leaves on peach grid

nodes.label: City Insider (Сити Инсайд) social media brand
nodes.rationale: St Petersburg city-guide social account ("всё про Питер"); every slide carries the circular C-arrow logo, and each rubric gets its own color palette and visual template for recognisability
